QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Ellin's Choice
QuestInfo.1:
Ellin was deep in thought for a long time and then told you that the Fairy Queen Ephenia became corrupted.
The camp must know this. Deliver Ephenia's letter to #bAthena Pierce#k in the #bCamp Conference Room#k.
QuestInfo.2:
Ellin hesitated for a long time, but revealed to you how the Fairy Queen Ephenia is cooperating with the Black Mage.
The queen's corruption means the corruption of the fairies.
To make this known, you delivered Athena Pierce the letter Ephenia wrote to Guwaru.

default.0: Hurry to #bAthena Pierce#k in the #bCamp Conference Room#k. They must know this.
